CHROMIUM: iwl7000: dbg: fill radio registers data regardless of fifos data dumping The driver calculates memory regions dump size, allocate memory and fills the data. The driver fills the radio registers data only if the memory size of the fifos is greater then zero, so in case the user masked out the fifos from the dump, the driver will skip filling the radio register data. Solve this by checking filling radio registers data independently from fifos data. CHROMIUM: iwl7000: use sync nmi in case of init flow failure In case of alive interrupt timeout or any failure in the init flow the driver generates FW nmi. The driver assumes that the nmi will generate SW interrupt. This assumption does not hold and leads to faulty behavior in the recovery flow. Solve this by using sync nmi, this way, even if the driver does not receive SW interrupt, it still starts the recovery flow. Also remove the wait queue from iwl_fwrt_stop_device since the driver is handling the SW interrupt synchronously. Change-Id: I478a05ba9a6f5639564b4d5e898a4fa389aaa545 Signed-off-by: Shahar S Matityahu <shahar.s.matityahu@intel.com> Signed-off-by: Luca Coelho <luciano.coelho@intel.com> iwl7000-tree: 7b8af35a82ab8e6dcad787403cadabcc2edd1e00 Signed-off-by: Luca Coelho <luciano.coelho@intel.com> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1566476 Commit-Ready: Kirtika Ruchandani <kirtika@chromium.org> Tested-by: Kirtika Ruchandani <kirtika@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Kirtika Ruchandani <kirtika@chromium.org>

tast: Introduce testing.Sleep. It is forbidden by tast-lint to use time.Sleep in test codes for two reasons: it does not honor context timeout, and also sleeping can be a cause of flakiness. However we got some legitimate use cases of sleep (like sending keyboard events) in more and more tests, so it's good time to introduce a utility function for it. Clean up telemetry_Crosperf and handle failed tests The `run_benchmark` command no longer needs to be run in background since profiling has been integrated into it. Cleaned up all codes related to background command. Meanwhile, when the command runs correctly but the test fails, the command will return 1 other than throwing an error. So we also want to handle it so that the error will not be hidden. TEST=Tested with several telemetry_Crosperf tests.
